theme: Last day ashore before a week under sail.
greeting: Your last stretch of dry land in Dubrovnik, Dan. Square away the shore logistics while the connection still holds, then the charter takes over.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat shore logistics before you sail
needsAttention.detail: The Cavtat hotel is booked, but the transfer on the 19th, the bag hold, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout all need arranging from land. Connectivity thins once the charter is underway, and the hotel's free-cancellation window closes the 15th.

needsAttention.title: Confirm boarding and the return transfer
needsAttention.detail: Lock the exact Nautilus meeting spot and the Sept 19 airport transfer with the instructor while you are still ashore, rather than from the boat.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: Mike's 15-minute board sweep is on your calendar for 9 AM tomorrow. A glance at what's active in the shared board beforehand is the agenda you'll open with.

schedule.title: Board the Nautilus charter
schedule.detail: Dubrovnik marina - a week under sail begins

flagged.title: NYT VP, Government Affairs surfaced
flagged.detail: LinkedIn's alert flagged a Vice President, Government Affairs role at The New York Times among openings like your saved searches.

inbox.noise: Otherwise just language-lesson digests, an Airbnb host review, and trip confirmations.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Duck breasts with apples & caraway
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first crisp apples, a natural match for rich duck.

tasks.title: Book Sept 20 - Oct 5 rental SUV at TPA

acts.line: A quiet morning in Dubrovnik with the Old Port apartment as your base - the last of the shore errands before you cast off.
Provision for the week: local cash, snacks, and any gluten-free items that won't be easy to find once at sea.
Board the charter around 5 and settle in; the wifi thins the moment you leave the marina.
